fieldValues.title: srs-context proves its own currency in every brief
fieldValues.move: The session hook removes stray writes that already exist on origin, fast-forwards, and lists any that do not by name. A record is suspect when a path its pointers name has a commit on the default branch after its last_verified (read from origin, never a sibling working tree); the dream re-verifies suspects first. The brief opens with one line: the commit it is served from, how far behind, and the suspect records by title, so an agent trusts everything else.
fieldValues.does_not_fix: It does not catch drift in a record with no code pointer (a concept or a practice); those still rely on the dream's age-based re-verification.
fieldValues.falsifier: A session's brief shows 0 behind and 0 suspect while a record it serves contradicts the code on the default branch; or the main clone stays behind origin for more than one session.
